map.what: first-half home margin = a + b x M, M = minus the closing full-game consensus spread (median of the bettable books' last pre-tip spread)

table.what: rows [closing consensus home spread, first-half home margin, games]; the table's key is a + b x (minus the spread)

tilt.what: dm = (h1 margin - period-2 margin) - (alpha + beta x Mc); tau = (this season's ended dm + w_prev x last season's) / (games + w_prev x last season's games + k)

command: python -m scripts.ncaab_first_half_spread_build --cache <copy of the four reads> --last-season 2026

replay.rule: every game, no games-played wait; best book; edge > cut
